actual_request.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. A small single change to Image1 for one NW13 walking sprite, native at least 1024x1024, transparent.
Keep the SCREEN-RIGHT LEG AND BOOT EXACTLY AS THEY ARE, planted flat. This is the farther anatomical RIGHT support leg. It must stay clearly visible and distinct.
Change ONLY THE SCREEN-LEFT LEG AND BOOT: bend its knee a little, and lift its boot about 35 pixels ABOVE its current ground location on the 1254 canvas. This is the nearer anatomical LEFT swing leg. Its boot stays on the SCREEN-LEFT side with an obvious transparent gap to the screen-right supporting boot. No overlap of boots, no crossed ankles. It passes low under her body while moving upper-left; point its sole toward the ground and avoid showing a large sole. One stationary planted RIGHT foot at screen-right; one lightly lifted LEFT foot at screen-left.
Preserve everything above the knees: original northwest rear-three-quarter direction, hands, complete spear, face visibility, brown double buns and long tails, red/ivory/gold costume, short chibi scale and full framing. Image2 confirms original character identity ONLY. Image3 confirms MAIN STYLE: bright clean rounded hand-painted Daoist chibi, not UI. Entire head, hair, spear tip/butt and boots inside margins. Actual transparent alpha; no ground/shadow/checkerboard/text/guides. Highest visual finish.
